upstream_fix_review.details: Right: the checks are now unconditional (arch_sub.c:396, 442-446), the 0xbebebebe archExit() of 7.0.17 is gone, archSubArchFree() skips NULL fields (arch_sub.c:195-202), and the inner Arch is now owned by the body from the start of Build (arch_sub.c:383), i.e. the same ownership protocol as our 0001. Wrong: (1) the newly unconditional fail1 path (arch_sub.c:448-452) frees termtab, which was already recorded in the body at arch_sub.c:425, so archSubArchFree() (called by archLoad() or by SCOTCH_archExit() after a failed SCOTCH_archSub()) frees it again: 'sub 2 0 99 cmplt 4' and 'sub 2 0 0 cmplt 4' -> 'AddressSanitizer: attempting double-free ... #1 _SCOTCHarchSubArchFree arch_sub.c:202 #2 _SCOTCHarchLoad arch.c:216; freed by ... _SCOTCHarchSubArchBuild arch_sub.c:451' (new defect PS3-G01-1: in 7.0.17 release builds this path did not exist). Incomplete: (2) the inner Arch allocated at arch_sub.c:112 is still never archInit()ed, so when its own loading fails, archLoad() calls its class free hook on an uninitialized body: 'sub 2 0 1 sub 3 0' -> 'arch.c:173:15: runtime error: member access within misaligned address 0xbebebebebebebebe' via archSubArchFree arch_sub.c:196; 'sub 2 0 1 tleaf abc' -> SEGV in free; malloc-failure sweep on a plain build: sub_sub.tgt crashes for failed malloc #5-9, sub_tleaf.tgt and sub_cmpltw.tgt for #5; (3) the fail2 path (arch_sub.c:472-484) frees only the first tree block, so the 'internal error (2)' and 'cannot create sub-architecture (2)' paths still leak the coarser blocks, and in the SCOTCH_archSub() path the published termtab is leaked unless the caller calls SCOTCH_archExit(); (4) vnumnbr == 0 is still accepted by both the loader ('termnbr < 0', arch_sub.c:92) and Build (arch_sub.c:396), so 'sub 0 cmplt 4' reaches memAllocGroup() with size 2*0-1 < 0 ('AddressSanitizer: requested allocation size 0xffffffffffffffec' from arch_sub.c:403); (5) single-terminal sub-architectures other than vertex 0 (PS2-G01-1) are not addressed: they now fail with 'internal error (2)' instead of crashing. Cosmetic: comment typo 'sob-architecture' (arch_sub.c:122).
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0001 used the same ownership protocol but (a) archInit()ed the inner Arch, (b) published the body fields only on success and (c) freed the whole tree chain once on every late failure: all three are what upstream still lacks, and (b) is exactly what prevents his new double free. His version is better in one respect: the archDomTerm() check is now unconditional (ours folded it into the message chain too). Rebased 0001 = his code + (a), (b), (c); rebased 0002 = the 'vnumnbr < 1' remainder of our 0002.

review_accuracy: accurate on mechanism, location and reproducer. Its 'Fix' line also asks to validate the archDomTerm() result unconditionally: for an in-range number this cannot fail in any class that has a matcher (archCmpltDomTerm, archHcubDomTerm, archMesh*DomTerm, archTleafDomTerm, archSubDomTerm, archDeco2DomTerm only reject numbers >= size), so it is an internal consistency check; patch 0002 keeps it as 'internal error (1)' in the same chain. The review missed that the debug check itself lets vnumnbr == 0 through (domnnbr = -1) and that a negative count reaches memAlloc in the loader.
first_pass_critique: Status, method and preferred option are right, and its diff is close to patch 0002. Shortcomings: it did not cite the in-tree precedent that settles the question (archDeco2ArchBuild, arch_deco2_build.c:604-615, already performs the same two checks unconditionally with the same messages); it reports the archDomTerm() failure as a user-facing 'invalid terminal number' although it is unreachable; it left the loader's count unchecked, so 'sub -1 ...' still reports a misleading 'out of memory (1)' and 'sub 0 ...' goes through memAlloc(0) before being rejected in Build (patch 0002 rejects both at 'bad input (1)', like archCmpltArchLoad's 'termnbr < 1'). Its option B is correctly marked weaker (does not protect SCOTCH_archSub).

upstream_fix_review.details: Right: well-formed 'dist' files now load, save and reload (dist_ok, dist_sub, dist_subsub: ret=0, no report), the inner Arch is allocated, the new archDistArchFree() is registered and renamed in module.h, and matching routines make 'dist' usable inside 'sub' ('sub 2 0 1 dist 2 cmplt 4' loads and round-trips). Incomplete: (1) archDistArchFree() (arch_dist.c:161-164) does not check archptr->archptr, which is set only on success (arch_dist.c:111), so every malformed 'dist' file crashes in the clean-up that archLoad() performs: 'dist abc' and 'dist 2 cmplt abc' -> 'arch.c:173:15: runtime error: member access within null pointer of type struct Arch ... #1 _SCOTCHarchDistArchFree arch_dist.c:162' then SEGV; a plain-build malloc-failure sweep crashes dist_ok.tgt at #3 and dist_sub/dist_subsub at every failure from #3 on; (2) the inner Arch (arch_dist.c:101) is not archInit()ed, so a nested 'dist'/'sub' whose loading fails frees garbage ('dist 2 dist 3 cmplt abc', 'dist 2 sub 3 0' -> 0xbebebebe); (3) a loaded 'dist' does not inherit ARCHVAR/ARCHPART from its inner architecture, which archDistArchBuild() does (arch_dist.c:186): 'dist 2 varcmplt' reports var=0 size=1 and gmap maps all 16 vertices of m4x4 onto one domain, while 'varcmplt' alone spreads them; (4) crloval < 1 is accepted ('dist 0 cmplt 4' loads; kgraphInit() rejects it only under SCOTCH_DEBUG_KGRAPH2, kgraph.c:98-103); (5) archDistArchBuild() still copies ARCHFREE from the original architecture, which it does not own: latent double free (no caller). He also added a regression test (0d878bdd), which ours did not.

review_accuracy: accurate; both fix directions it offers are valid, and 'allocate and free the inner Arch' is the one taken.
first_pass_critique: Status, evidence and option A are right and close to patch 0003. upstream_change: ecaf094ef7 'Make sub-architecture architecture loading and building more robust': makes the count/range/duplicate checks and the archDomTerm() check of archSubArchBuild() unconditional, rejects negative counts and terminal numbers in archSubArchLoad(), stops archExit()ing the inner Arch, makes archSubArchFree() NULL-tolerant, and sets subarchptr->archptr at the entry of archSubArchBuild() so that archSubArchFree() frees the inner Arch on failure.

upstream_fix_review.details: Right: the checks are now unconditional (arch_sub.c:396, 442-446), the 0xbebebebe archExit() of 7.0.17 is gone, archSubArchFree() skips NULL fields (arch_sub.c:195-202), and the inner Arch is now owned by the body from the start of Build (arch_sub.c:383), i.e. the same ownership protocol as our 0001. Wrong: (1) the newly unconditional fail1 path (arch_sub.c:448-452) frees termtab, which was already recorded in the body at arch_sub.c:425, so archSubArchFree() (called by archLoad() or by SCOTCH_archExit() after a failed SCOTCH_archSub()) frees it again: 'sub 2 0 99 cmplt 4' and 'sub 2 0 0 cmplt 4' -> 'AddressSanitizer: attempting double-free ... #1 _SCOTCHarchSubArchFree arch_sub.c:202 #2 _SCOTCHarchLoad arch.c:216; freed by ... _SCOTCHarchSubArchBuild arch_sub.c:451' (new defect PS3-G01-1: in 7.0.17 release builds this path did not exist). Incomplete: (2) the inner Arch allocated at arch_sub.c:112 is still never archInit()ed, so when its own loading fails, archLoad() calls its class free hook on an uninitialized body: 'sub 2 0 1 sub 3 0' -> 'arch.c:173:15: runtime error: member access within misaligned address 0xbebebebebebebebe' via archSubArchFree arch_sub.c:196; 'sub 2 0 1 tleaf abc' -> SEGV in free; malloc-failure sweep on a plain build: sub_sub.tgt crashes for failed malloc #5-9, sub_tleaf.tgt and sub_cmpltw.tgt for #5; (3) the fail2 path (arch_sub.c:472-484) frees only the first tree block, so the 'internal error (2)' and 'cannot create sub-architecture (2)' paths still leak the coarser blocks, and in the SCOTCH_archSub() path the published termtab is leaked unless the caller calls SCOTCH_archExit(); (4) vnumnbr == 0 is still accepted by both the loader ('termnbr < 0', arch_sub.c:92) and Build (arch_sub.c:396), so 'sub 0 cmplt 4' reaches memAllocGroup() with size 2*0-1 < 0 ('AddressSanitizer: requested allocation size 0xffffffffffffffec' from arch_sub.c:403); (5) single-terminal sub-architectures other than vertex 0 (PS2-G01-1) are not addressed: they now fail with 'internal error (2)' instead of crashing. Cosmetic: comment typo 'sob-architecture' (arch_sub.c:122).
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0001 used the same ownership protocol but (a) archInit()ed the inner Arch, (b) published the body fields only on success and (c) freed the whole tree chain once on every late failure: all three are what upstream still lacks, and (b) is exactly what prevents his new double free. His version is better in one respect: the archDomTerm() check is now unconditional (ours folded it into the message chain too). Rebased 0001 = his code + (a), (b), (c); rebased 0002 = the 'vnumnbr < 1' remainder of our 0002.

first_pass_critique: Right about the two returns, but incomplete: the '(2)' path also leaks every coarse tree block but the first, and the two SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2 paths leak more; and it says the leak was 'not triggered by my inputs' while a two-line API call triggers it in release builds.
